value: US Government work (public domain); NREL technical report

Ramsden, T., Steward, D. and Zuboy, J. (2009). Analyzing the Levelized Cost of Centralized and Distributed Hydrogen Production Using the H2A Production Model, Version 2. National Renewable Energy Laboratory, Golden, CO. Technical Report NREL/TP-560-46267, September 2009.

All 19 H2A v2 production cases loaded (10 technologies x current/future; nuclear HTE future only) from each case's Technical, Cost Input, Energy Input, Cost Results and Process Energy Results tables. Sensitivity tables/figures not loaded (a few nominal values in other-values). Reference = printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 11). All costs 2005$ (startup-year variable costs). Central capex = total initial capital (direct + indirect), total-plant basis; NPV replacement capital in other-values. Forecourt totals bundle compression/storage/dispensing (CSD), so only production-subsystem initial direct capital (installed basis) and production-only levelized costs are loaded; combined totals in other-values. SEC in MJ/kg are the LHV process-energy results; feed quantities (kg, Nm3, gal) in flows. Forecourt electrolysis process efficiency not printed. Coal and NG CCS capex include CO2 compressor, pipeline and injection. Coal-without-CCS efficiency counts byproduct electricity as output. No emissions factors are printed.
